reviews.t: You will find me dead before you ever take this cleansing balm off my hands.
reviews.x: Like many people, I've tried multiple foaming cleansers, "gentle" cleansers that strip your skin of every single oily molecule, St. Ives apricot scrubs, Korean face washes, Irish Spring green-bar of soap, plain water, micellar water, and a whole lot of useless products that do nothing.  I saw a few videos, along with multiple reviews of this specific cleansing balm and decided to give it a try. Why did it took me over 20 years to finally give in to using balms instead of soap? This thing is ridi

reviews.t: Smells great and works really well
reviews.x: I recently bought this cleansing balm because I was using the clinique balm which is probably twice as expensive, and so far I'm happy with this product. It cleans my waterproof mascara really well, it dissolves in your fingers just like the clinique balm and smells so nice, like the ocean. The ingredients are also beneficial for your skin. My skin is normal to dry and this balm contains oils which is perfect, however doesn't leave your skin oily. Overall a great buy.

So I will admit that I suck at regularly washing my face at night. I’m so tired after a long day I just can’t muster the energy. I have tried other balms like this and they were ok but I love this stuff! I use a pea size amount and it completely takes off my make up. I follow up with a cleanser and there is no make up left to get in the way. This stuff makes it easy to do a basic skincare routine in half the time. No residue. Gentle on my sensitive skin. No fragrance.

This has lasted me about 2 months. I really like it, it softens my face and does a pretty decent job to remove my makeup. I use a face wash afterwards to get rid of the left over gunk and my face feels so clean! I will more than likely purchase this again!

After seeing Dr Dray on YT using it and recommending it…I couldn’t get it my Amazon cart fast enough!! After a few shipping problems, it arrived. It has been difficult finding a cleansing balm which can be removed by my gentle cleanser. Usually the balm is so thick and oily which makes it very difficult to remove. The Mizon cleansing balm can almost be removed with water but with the gentle cleanser it can be removed 100%. I have normal to dry aging skin(45ish) and due to using sunscreen everyda

reviews.t: Makes face feel wonderfully clean & moist not striped.
reviews.x: Love, love this facial cleansing balm!  Very light fresh scent, melts into your skin and gives your face a clean, moisturized non-oily feel.

I have used the Farmacy cleansing balm for 3 years and this is the first time I have used another brand. I find this balm very hydrating. It removes waterproof makeup very well, has a very fresh scent and with a bit of water turns into a milky cleanser. It also comes with a scoop for sanitary use. Overall, it is a great cleansing balm at a reasonable price. Highly recommended.

I do like this cleanser, but beware if you have oily skin. It is super oily. I also do not feel like it takes off the dirt as well as other cleaners. My skin feels super soft after. I also think the packaging is super cute, and I appreciate the included applicator.  I love products with hyaluronic acid, so I am a fan of this product, especially for morning use.

I'm guilty of using makeup wipes in the past. After seeing numerous videos of these cleanser balms I figured I'd give one a try. This does not disappoint! It literally takes everything off! Waterproof eyeliner, waterproof mascara, full coverage foundation...a little goes a long way too. Just wipe it off with some microfiber cloths and be amazed :D

Have used many other balms to remove makeup and this is one of my favorites! Has beautiful blue gold packaging to look at and does the job of removing most of my makeup, like many balms usually do. This one in particular has no scent at all. It melts away as soon as you start using it and is great for travel. Highly recommend for price point too!

The balm comes with a little spatula so you’re not putting your fingers in the tub. It’s pretty much scent free. It melts easily into the skin and washes off cleanly with very little effort. I go right into a water cleanse but I don’t notice any tightness after cleansing. Seems to be a gentle cleansing balm. I’m please with it.

I like this cleansing balm fine. It was not the best one that I have ever used, but it’s not bad. I think you comes with less product than others that I have used and that’s a bad point por me. In general, I would buy that again because it works taking my makeup off and cleaning my face.

An almost perfect cleansing bomb experience for me. It turned into oil so easily, no clumps at all. It’s soft, emulsifies well, and takes sunscreen off easily(no film or leftover residue). But the smell of it is not pleasant at all for me, it was just a bad smell.
It feels like the Farmacy Green Clean or Versed Cleansing balm of any other balm to oil cleanser. It washes easy with water but I just wasn’t a fan of the smell so I won’t be repurchasing

reviews.t: Not as effective as my go to cleansing balm
reviews.x: It takes a little while rubbing the balm to absorb and melt my makeup… my previous cleansing balm (banila co) still works better.
Love it! Removes makeup with ease and leave skin hydrated. Will purchase again.

reviews.t: No scent - dissolves make up and the day- rinses easily
reviews.x: Amazing product!  Will definitely purchase again

reviews.t: Great Value Cleansing Balm for any Skin Type
reviews.x: The Mizon Cicaluronic Cleansing Balm is a nicely hydrating balm that works well as a first cleanse in a skincare routine. With a price coming in around $17, it's hard to beat its value and quality. With an opaque light blue appearance in the container, it immediately turns into oil after rubbing it in your hands. This balm's scent reminds me of a beach scented candle, and I haven't noticed any irritation to the skin using this product. With calming and hydrating ingredients like Hyaluronic acid

reviews.t: Cleansing balm that works deeply and leaves skin soft
reviews.x: I'm always interested in trying new skincare products, brands, and innovations.  Mizon is a well regarded South Korean skincare brand and its cleansing balm was gentle but effective.  It comes solid in the jar with a small scoop that helps keep your fingers from touching the balm.  After rubbing the balm together it turns liquid and goes on gently into the skin. I rubbed it further into my skin to help it cleanse deeply. The cleansing balm didn't feel greasy or sticky.  I  left it on for a few m

reviews.t: solid balm to oil cleanswer melts away gunk of the day; soothing & hydrating
reviews.x: Lovely gentle and effective balm to oil cleanser. I use it as my first step in dissolving the grime and skin care products I used during the day (mostly SPF,  I dont wear makeup but rarely). I have dry skin, semi sensitive and this is soothing feeling as well as non irritating. The combo of Centella Asiatica (soothing, skin health) and Hyaluronic Acid (retaining moisture) are the clear winning ingredients in this awesome oil cleanser.   I dab this oil cleanser all over the face, then let the hea

This makeup remover removes the toughest waterproof makeup ever. Just with a little bit of product, it does the job. I love it. If you have tried removing your makeup with coconut oil then you know what I'm talking about. This is exactly like that. I just add a tiny amount into my hands and massage through my face and rinse with warm water. Makes remover my makeup so much easier and I'm not afraid to use my waterproof mascara because I know this will remove it all. I love it.

I really like how smoothly this balm takes off my makeup, especially my waterproof eyeliner and mascara. You don't have to use a lot at all. A small amount goes a long way with breaking down the makeup. The only issue I have with it is that even with a little, it is very thick so removing my eye makeup makes it feel like im using vaseline so I have to use a face wipe to clean off the excess balm.

I've recently discovered hyaluronic acid and it is a godsend. I have very sensitive skin and it gets dry very easily, especially in the winter, but hyaluronic acid has saved me. Because of my sensitive skin I have to be careful with makeup removers and so this has been really great, moisturizes as it cleanses, and decently priced

I have tried multiple cleansing balms, and this one is my favorite right now. I love that it has no fragrance, I love how it feels on my dry sensitive skin, but mostly, I love how well it works. Sunscreen, makeup, waterproof mascara, it all just melts off. Worth it.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how effectively it removes makeup, including waterproof mascara and eyeliner.
Many describe it as hydrating and softening, leaving skin clean without tightness or stripping.
Opinions on scent are mixed: some find it light and pleasant, while others dislike the smell.
Several reviewers note it melts easily into an oil and emulsifies or washes off cleanly.
A few mention it can feel very oily or leave residue, especially for oily skin.
